# Nines Media

> Nines Media is a full-service digital marketing and creative agency based at Dainfern Square, Johannesburg, South Africa. Certified Google Partner and Meta Business Partner. Services: Google Ads and PPC management, Meta (Facebook & Instagram) advertising, SEO, social media management, content marketing, branding and web design. Packages from R5,000 per month, month-to-month, quoted individually after a free audit.

## Key facts
- Legal entity: IMC Media (Pty) Ltd, trading as Nines Media
- Address: 1st Floor, Dainfern Square, Cnr William Nicol & Broadacres Dr, Dainfern, Johannesburg, Gauteng, 2191, South Africa
- Phone: +27 78 697 5931 (also WhatsApp)
- Email: info@ninesmedia.co.za
- Website: https://www.ninesmedia.com
- Certifications: Google Partner; Meta Business Partner
- Service area: Johannesburg, Sandton, Fourways, Pretoria, Centurion and the rest of Gauteng; Cape Town, Durban and nationwide across South Africa
- Head of Strategy: Brandon Howard (https://www.ninesmedia.com/team/brandon-howard.html, https://www.linkedin.com/in/brandon-howard-54b022397/)

## Pricing (starting points; every engagement is quoted after a free audit)
- Starter: from R5,000/month — one paid channel (Google or Meta), setup, optimisation, monthly reporting
- Growth: from R12,000/month — Google Ads + Meta, social media on two platforms, landing page optimisation, weekly reporting
- Full Service: from R25,000/month — all paid channels incl. LinkedIn, full social, content, SEO, real-time dashboards
- Websites from R15,000; brand identity from R8,000; video production from R6,500
- Ad spend is billed separately and paid directly to Google/Meta/LinkedIn; clients own their ad accounts; no lock-in contracts

## FAQ
- What does Nines Media do? Nines Media is a Johannesburg digital marketing agency that runs Google Ads, Meta advertising, SEO, social media, content, branding and websites for South African businesses.
- How much does Nines Media charge? Packages start from R5,000/month (Starter), R12,000/month (Growth) and R25,000/month (Full Service). Ad spend is separate.
- Is Nines Media a Google Partner? Yes, Nines Media is a certified Google Partner and Meta Business Partner.
- Are there contracts? No. Packages are month-to-month and clients own their ad accounts.
- How do I get started? Request a free audit at https://www.ninesmedia.com/free-audit.html — a strategist reviews your ads, website and competitors and sends a written report with a tailored quote.
